task: Explore: regression discontinuity as a research-algorithm tool
errors: First fuzzy bias-corrected estimate took the ratio of the two corrected jumps (0.0028 off rdrobust); fixed by linearising the ratio's bias.
First HC1 and nn robust SEs differed from rdrobust in the 6th-8th digit; fixed by restricting to the max(h,b) window and counting that window in HC1's n.
First density check (symmetric-window binomial) false-alarmed at p=0.001 on the example's sloped density; replaced in the summary by McCrary's test.

Two repo lints failed in CI on the first push: test_inherited_keys (KERNELS[o.kernel]) and test_csv_thousands_split (a .split(",") beside a comma-stripping number reader); fixed with Object.hasOwn and a regex split.

doc_friction.issue: Says to create the work branch; the harness had already created and checked out claude/cool-franklin-ulxwm7, so `git checkout -b` failed. Minor.

A new research tool needs four out-of-folder registrations (build.mjs slug list, launched.json, optout-switches.txt, this table) found by reading an earlier tool's merge commit; open PR #16932 (register-tool.mjs) would remove that step.

The unwired tree checks (test_inherited_keys, test_csv_thousands_split) only surface inside run_venture_tests' changed-ventures step; running the venture's own node --test is not enough, and the local sweep took ~5 min to show them.

notes: Explore idea: regression discontinuity as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/regression-discontinuity); no venture README mentioned it, sits beside difference-in-differences and synthetic-control. Engine from Calonico-Cattaneo-Titiunik 2014 (robust bias-corrected CI), Calonico-Cattaneo-Farrell 2020 (MSE bandwidth, own plug-in), McCrary 2008. rdrobust 2.1.1 is GPL-3.0 so it was run only as a black box: 14 fixed-bandwidth cases (sharp/fuzzy, p 0-3, 3 kernels, nn/HC0-3, ties) agree within 1e-8. Own bandwidth lands 0.75-1.06x rdbwselect mserd on 6 designs. Monte Carlo on Lee calibration: robust CI 93.7% vs conventional 91.7% (1000 draws); same 500 draws: this tool 93.2% (mean h 0.172) vs rdrobust 91.8% (mean h 0.199). Local CI via run_workflow_locally --for-changes; see PR. No agent doc: the README carries everything a next run needs.
